mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in tightening periods than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of declining GDP (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing industrial production (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 5% in a month signals a weakening demand side, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of decreasing housing starts (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing nonfarm payrolls (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation exceeds 3% year-over-year, the combined effect signals a tightening monetary policy and high inflation, which increases borrowing costs and erodes real earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of high inflation and high interest rates (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is negative and the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% in a month, the combined effect signals a weakening economy, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 0 and UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of negative GDP growth and rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
